```sql
SELECT 
    sum(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.currency = 'AUD' THEN t.line_total * fx.aud_nzd_rate
            ELSE t.line_total
        END
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON t.txn_date = fx.rate_date
WHERE s.store_name LIKE '%Sydney%'
  AND t.txn_date >= '2025-10-01'
  AND t.txn_date <= '2025-10-31'
  AND t.txn_type = 'SALE'
  AND t.is_valid = true;
```
